title: Vietnamese Bryndza Cheese Dumplings
description: These malty and springy dumplings feature bryndza cheese and are inspired by Vietnamese cuisine, making for a romantic and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly dish.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine wheat flour and salt.
Gradually add warm water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a tablespoon of crumbly bryndza cheese in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the cheese to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Heat sesame oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Serve the dumplings hot with chopped scallions, grated ginger, and soy sauce for dipping.
